steps.decide: The one decision this page exists to support, and where the buy controls sit relative to it
Variant selection behaviour: what changes on screen, what changes the URL, what changes the price
Availability and delivery statements, and how uncertainty is worded
Add-to-cart feedback and the duplicate-submit guard

rules.statement: The page supports one decision (buy this configuration); secondary actions do not compete with it at the same weight.
Changing a variant updates price, availability and image together or says which of them is unchanged; a silently stale price is a defect, not a polish item.
Availability is stated as observed (In stock, 3 left, Usually ships in 2 days); a countdown or scarcity claim that is not real data is prohibited.
Add-to-cart disables on press, the handler refuses a second in-flight request, and the request carries an idempotency key reused on retry; the control states the result inline.
Confirmation appears next to the control that caused it, with a route to the cart; a toast alone loses the context on scroll.

stateMachine.staleResponseRule: a response for a superseded variant selection is discarded; the page reflects the currently selected variant only

motion.noneReason: the press is over; the next thing the shopper needs is the result
the request is the feedback; animating the start delays it
motion.reducedMotion: label swaps instantly and repeats the variant name

motion.noneReason: a commercial error must never wait for an animation
motion.reducedMotion: the error appears instantly with the reason

refused.reason: an unavailable variant cannot be added

sections.intent: Support one decision: buy this configuration, with price, availability and result all telling the same story.
nicheDifferences: Apparel needs size and fit guidance; electronics need compatibility
Digital goods need licence terms rather than shipping
styling: Buy control is the single dominant action
Price changes announced rather than animated
Gallery does not push the buy control below the fold at 390px
a11y: Price change announced in a live region
Buy control reachable before detail sections
responsive: Buy control reachable within one scroll at 390px
Sticky buy bar does not overlap content
copy: No countdown without a real reservation
alternatives: A quick-view dialog is legitimate from a grid
Hiding price behind a quote form is a decision that must be stated

references.label: Project convention: variant truth (price, availability, image together) (T0405c)

acceptance: Variant change updates price, availability and image together
Add to cart confirms inline with a cart route
failureCases: Two add-to-cart requests from one press
